Sixth TU reconstruction pilot (ov002/daCamTag_c), now PROMOTED. The text-verified-era note that stood here has been retired because the rename falsified it: it argued that this class's own _ZTI/_ZTS could never be byte-compared because the ROM's RTTI name was a different string length than the decomp's, and deferred them to Phase F. The decomp's name at the time was the coined `CameraTag`; the class now carries the cartridge's own spelling, _ZTS10daCamTag_c, so the records compare exactly and are licensed as deadstrip-data. The note also described a D2 deadstrip row and an externalized_output block, both of which are gone: the inline destructor emits no D2 base-object body, and the six inherited base-chain RTTI records are carried by compiler_only_output instead. What survives from that round and still holds is the shadow-struct reconciliation against include/daCamTag_c.h and the 8/8 byte match.

Promoted filename uses the snake_case scheme in notes/tu-naming-and-swallowers.md sec 1 (tools/tu_names.py): daCamTag_c -> d_a_cam_tag. The class was renamed from the coined `CameraTag` to the cartridge RTTI spelling first (tools/class_rename.py), which is what lets this TU emitted _ZTI/_ZTS/_ZTV records be word-compared against the ROM.
